name: dyad
description: A serializable, versioned database type IR for TypeScript. Captures RDBMS types without lowest-common-denominator loss. Parsers for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite. Projections to TypeScript and JSON Schema.
author: Joshua Skootsky
